candidate.title: 2P-seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina 2P-seq row: poly(A)-primed sequencing to quantify usage of known poly(A) sites. Starting at Poly(A)-selected RNA, the single serial route depicts partial RNase T1 digestion, anchored oligo(dT) reverse transcription, the combined Circularize and PCR block, and sequencing at the terminal cDNA/readout interface. No split, pooling or alternative is drawn. The yellow-highlighted poly(A) motif at left is explanatory, not another branch. Neighboring cP-RNA-Seq, 3P-Seq and 3′-Seq rows and the right-hand chemical legend are outside the assigned target. The matched collection page is headed 2P-Seq: Poly(A)-Tail-Primed Sequencing and depicts this same route. The Spies et al. implementation clarifies cDNA strandedness and the discrepant sequencing-primer caption; unshown application experiments are not part of this extraction.

states.label: 2P-seq sequence tags reporting known poly(A)-site usage
features: Sequence data are read from cDNA, not directly from the starting RNA.
For cDNA genuinely primed at a poly(A) tail, the first sequenced base corresponds to the original mRNA’s 3′-most non-A nucleotide.
Tag abundance associated with independently known poly(A) sites supports quantification of the corresponding 3′ UTR isoforms.
Internal priming at encoded A-rich regions can yield misleading tags; independent poly(A)-site annotation constrains interpretation.

operations.label: T1 RNase partial digest
operations.description: Partially cleave the poly(A)-selected RNA into shorter fragments while retaining poly(A)-tailed 3′ fragments, shown as interrupted purple RNA still ending in AA (A)n.
operations.mechanism: Partial RNase T1 digestion; the primary paper states that RNase T1 does not cleave within the poly(A) tail.
operations.information_effect: Shortens RNA templates while retaining terminal-region sequence and poly(A) needed for priming. It does not establish perfect poly(A)-site specificity.

operations.label: Reverse transcription
operations.description: Anneal the anchored oligo(dT) primer to poly(A)-containing RNA and extend a DNA copy. The product proceeds to circularization; the paper specifies single-stranded cDNA at that interface.
operations.mechanism: RNA-templated reverse transcription initiated with the 20T-VN primer; annealing and extension are represented within this local block.
operations.information_effect: Transfers adjoining mRNA sequence to cDNA containing the primer. Internal A-rich regions may also prime, so the tag-to-poly(A)-site association remains conditional.
